title_orig: Ἱστορία τῶν Ἀρειανῶν πρὸς μονάχους (Historia Arianorum ad monachos)
title_es: Historia de los arrianos (a los monjes)
title_en: History of the Arians (To the Monks)
translator_edition: Trans. M. Atkinson and Archibald Robertson, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (Buffalo 1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/2815.htm (parts 28154 and 28158).
original_edition: Migne PG 25 (Athanasius I). Greek read in the Google-scanned PG 25 text on archive.org (https://archive.org/download/patrologiae_cursus_completus_gr_vol_025/patrologiae_cursus_completus_gr_vol_025_djvu.txt); the column for §67 is not reliably read from the OCR (not stated).
notes: Section 33 is in part IV (newadvent 28154.htm); section 67 is in part VIII (28158.htm). The brief's wording 'axes and swords' is not in the source: the English reads 'axes and hammers'. The Greek for §33 opens in an OCR-garbled stretch; only the legible Greek is recorded.

title_orig: Περὶ τῶν ἐν Νικαίᾳ δογμάτων (De Decretis Nicaenae Synodi)
title_es: Sobre los decretos del Concilio de Nicea
title_en: Defence of the Nicene Definition (De Decretis)
translator_edition: Trans. John Henry Newman, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/2809.htm.
original_edition: Migne PG 25 (Athanasius I), De Decretis. Greek NOT readable at the passage (Google-scanned PG 25 OCR garbled there).
notes: Section 28 contains 'Who but would stone such madmen?' (own voice). The English idiom 'who but would' means 'who would not'. The sentence is rhetorical, inside an argument about the word 'unoriginate'.

translator_edition: Trans. M. Atkinson and Archibald Robertson, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/2813.htm.
original_edition: Migne PG 25 (Athanasius I). Greek NOT read.
notes: §30 reproduces a letter of Constantius 'to the Alexandrians' (a quoted opponent). §29 reports rumoured letters to the Princes of Auxumis that would have had the non-complying put to death; this is reported, not endorsed.

title_orig: Περὶ τῆς ἐνανθρωπήσεως τοῦ Λόγου (De Incarnatione Verbi Dei)
title_en: On the Incarnation of the Word
translator_edition: Trans. Archibald Robertson, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/2802.htm.
original_edition: Migne PG 25 (Athanasius I), De Incarnatione. Greek of §12 read in the PG 25 OCR (partial, OCR-corrected); §40 Greek NOT located.
notes: Section numbers in the NPNF text are the ones used here. The Greek section numbers in the OCR (e.g. '50.') do not match NPNF numbering.

title_orig: Περὶ τῶν Συνόδων (De Synodis Arimini et Seleuciae)
title_es: Sobre los concilios de Arímino y Seleucia
title_en: On the Councils of Ariminum and Seleucia (De Synodis)
translator_edition: Trans. John Henry Newman and Archibald Robertson, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/2817.htm.
original_edition: Migne PG 26 (Athanasius II). Greek NOT read.
notes: §45 compares the Apostle's statements about the Law across letters (Romans, Hebrews, Galatians, 1 Timothy).

title_orig: Λόγοι κατὰ Ἀρειανῶν Β' (Orationes contra Arianos II)
translator_edition: Trans. John Henry Newman and Archibald Robertson, in NPNF2 vol. 4 (1892); public domain. Read at newadvent.org/fathers/28162.htm.
original_edition: Migne PG 26 (Athanasius II). Greek NOT read.
authenticity_note: genuine (Orationes contra Arianos accepted as Athanasian)
notes: §§7–9 comment on Hebrews 2:17 and 3:1–2 (wording quoted without the Heb reference in §9). §8 uses Aaron as a 'shadow' of Christ.
